main_text.p: densatis nubibus motu celeri accensæ erumpūt, lūmenq; de se spargunt.
Flatulentum tantūm est, quod in nube ex fumo sicciore generatur. ut Procella & Turbo.
Procella est flatus vehemens, qui ex nube deorsum spectante impetuose erumpens, simul res obvias prosternit ac percellit: ita ut quandoq; ædificia diruat, arboresq; e radicibus evellat.

Turbo seu Vortex est flatus vehemens, qui ex nube obliquè erumpens, & rapida vertigine deorsum tendens, obvia quæq; in gyrum secum contorquet: ita ut quandoq; lapides secum elevet, quæ alibi rursum decidant.
Turbini simile quid accidit, quando vel duo venti contrarii magno impetu sibi occurrunt: vel et-jam unus ventus validè spirans in locum angu-stiorem incidit, unde repercussus in gyrum contorquetur.
Ignitum & flatulentum simul meteoron est, quod ex utriusq; horum materia in nube generatur.
Fulmen quidem, quando igniti materia super-rat flatulenti materiam, quæ erumpens e nubi-bus accenditur.
Sonus provenit ex materiæ fulminis, exitum quærentis, ad latera nubis collisione.
Hic sonus duplex est: tonitru & fragor.

page.notes: Catchword "men," at the lower right. Last word "ful-" is a printed hyphenated line end. "prester" is doubtful: the print looks like "prefter" or "prester". Line-initial "tantūm" has a tilde over the u, read as a left-out m. "quærentis" is read from a ligature that could be "querentis". The paragraph breaks before "Hic" and "Tonitru" are inferred from indents.
